name: Code Shot
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Turn code into a gorgeous, share-ready image. Paste a snippet or import a file, pick a language and a theme, add a window frame, line numbers and a background, and drop it in as a re-editable layer. Emphasise lines with a focus mode, show additions and removals with diff tinting, choose from nine editor themes, frame it to a social-ready ratio, or copy it straight to your clipboard. Syntax highlighting runs locally in your browser - nothing is uploaded. Supports dynamic content: the code and the title can be bound to WordPress fields with {{...}} tokens, so a design re-renders per post for dynamic featured images.
